name: Inkou Karen Doukoukai
source:
Airi has just moved to a new school. She has a friendly personality and makes friends soon. But, there is one student she never meets. It's Rikka. She doesn't come to school often. One day, Rikka comes to school, and Airi is surprised to see her pretty face. After school, Airi goes to a sick-room and sees Rikka having sex with a male student...!

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
艾里刚刚搬到新学校。她性格友善，很快就交到了朋友。但是，有一个她从未见过的学生。是立夏。她不常来学校。有一天，六花来到学校，爱理惊讶地看到她漂亮的脸庞。放学后，爱理来到病房，看到立夏与一名男学生发生性关系……！
